target: AArch64 PCI QEMU/HVF with disposable VirtIO disk clone
result: pass: explicitly mounted D: reports writable; BlkWrite changed one sector inside the 128-sector RedSea window, readback matched, original bytes were restored and verified, and writes immediately before and after the window threw Drive; zstatus failed=0
scope: All writes were limited by TaskBridge to D:'s absolute sector window at LBA 130911 through 131038 and run only against the harness's disposable copy-on-write QEMU disk clone. This is a bounded low-level BlkWrite backend. It does not register the stock drive in blkdev.let_to_drive, implement stock RedSea create/delete/rename or general FileWrite persistence, add lock/cache/hotplug behavior, support Pi SDHCI writes, or constitute physical Pi/UTM acceptance. The separate stock DiskCheck call was excluded from this write regression because its intentionally inconsistent geometry fixture emits PrintWarn, which is not bound in this bootstrap shell.
